explanation: Only active at D1, and only when the previous trial reached S2 and was rewarded, i.e. an unexpected S2 reward: about 10 if the agent had been choosing a1 (S2 reached by a rare transition) and the trial before that was unrewarded, 7-9 if a1-rare-S2 was rewarded after an earlier reward, and about 6 (then 3, then 0) when the agent already chooses a2 and gets an S2 reward right after a loss (each further S2 reward in a row gives less). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 after an S1 reward or after no reward.
